confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are rough: they rest on Peru-wide cost-of-living indexes and older Cusco and Lima tourist-venue reports, adjusted for Paracas's waterfront tourist premium. Coffee, beer, and meal anchors are medium-low; cocktail and wine_glass are low. Wine has no direct source, so wine_glass uses the beer anchor times about 2 as its basis, and the cocktail is set from scattered pisco sour reports. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not from live booking pages or current listings. The FX observation is the 2026-03-20 RBA figure from a search-result summary, not a fetched RBA page, and it is about seven months older than the generation date, so it has not been verified as the latest observation; refresh it before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Peru-wide cost-of-living indexes (Bearsavings, Trek.zone, Expatistan) and Cusco and Lima tourist-venue figures, scaled down for a smaller coastal town and up for the Malecón tourist premium. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small resort town with hostels, guesthouses, and mid-range hotels.
